summary: Frontend-only Playwright testing at 390x844 of the new FATE POINTS rewards system and PARCHMENT INTRO field guide on the public preview URL. Ran 3 scripted flows: (1) fresh-device parchment gating + checkbox seal + reload behavior, (2) daily-login points claim + realm chooser + Fate Points pill/dialog with insufficient balance, (3) seeded-balance (600 pts) two-tap redemption, coupon minting/persistence, plus regressions (Skip intro, Trophy Room accordion, SaveProgress backup, footer How to play). All 30+ assertions passed; no console errors, no broken flows.

issues: Bottom hint line 'Reopen anytime from "How to play" in the footer.' renders over the parchment's decorative art (teacup/dice/leaves) at the very bottom edge and is nearly illegible at 390px (italic 10px, low contrast over illustrations). Consider more bottom padding or moving the hint above the CTA.
Minor: 'Valid through … · one use per visit' uses text-white/50 at 12px on near-black — borderline contrast; consider white/70.

action_items: Optional polish only: improve legibility of the parchment footer hint line; slightly raise contrast of coupon validity text. No functional fixes required.
critical_code_review_comments: points.js readPoints() coerces any non-positive/NaN value to 0 — a corrupted ff_points silently resets the balance; acceptable but worth documenting.
claimDaily/streak state is device-local with no clock-tamper guard (device date change can farm daily points). Acceptable for demo currency.
RewardsDialog two-tap confirm never auto-resets — the 'Confirm?' state stays armed until another tap or dialog close; consider reverting after ~4s to avoid accidental double-tap redemption.
seed_data_creation: localStorage seeds only: ff_guide_seen=1, ff_theme_chosen=1, ff_points=600, ff_points_day=today (device-local; no server data touched).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: parchment shows before realm chooser on fresh device; unchecked close leaves ff_guide_seen unset and it reappears on reload; checked close sets ff_guide_seen=1 and suppresses it; footer how-to-play reopens it and its close does NOT reopen the realm chooser. Daily claim awards exactly +10 at ~4s with toast, gated by ff_points_day (no second toast same day). RewardsDialog portals to document.body and covers full viewport (0,0,390,844); all 4 demo sponsors listed; redeem buttons disabled at 10 pts. With 600 pts seeded: neon-noodle first tap -> 'Confirm?', second tap deducts 250 (balance 350 in dialog + pill + localStorage), coupon view shows FF-XXXX-XXXX code (e.g. FF-93D3-8VZ5), copy button, 7-day validity, and the coupon persists in rewards-coupon-list after close/reopen. Regressions pass: theme-welcome-option-light enters app, Skip intro, trophy-room-btn accordion links, save-progress-backup toast 'Progress saved!'. Heist/ritual awards were NOT live-tested (random timers) per instructions.
